BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning death benefits provided by the 1955 act for firefighters' relief and pensions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to death benefits provided by the 1955 act for firefighters' relief and pensions; and amending RCW 41.18.140.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. RCW 41.18.140 and 2007 c 218 s 54 are each amended to read as follows:Funeral expenses.
BillSection.P: The board shall pay from the firefighters' pension fund upon the death of any active or retired firefighter the sum of five hundred dollars $1,000, to assist in defraying the funeral expenses of such firefighter.

AnnNote.NoteP: Intent—Finding—2007 c 218: See note following RCW 41.08.020.
